set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KYSSZRDP783ZZ20EC7CK28M4. PRD phase PH1A semantic scope and requirement SPT-004. Implement the frozen spatial4s-core Frame, Point, Vec, unit, convention, affine, identity, immutable-registry, and alignment contracts in the sibling spatial4s repository with JVM and Scala.js laws. Documentation must distinguish spatial4s.Frame, a coordinate frame, from the unrelated frame4s typed dataframe library. Publication, immutable mesh4s pinning, fresh-checkout resolution, image4s re-exports, and reframe4s migration are tracked separately; only the first three remain mesh4s release gates under bd-01KYSZSHW1ZRR2XW1T17H71ZPA.
